select ctel.id as id, ctel.create_time as createTime, user_a.name as userName, concat(ifnull(enter.country_name, ''), ifnull(enter.province_name, ''), ifnull(enter.city_name, ''), ifnull(enter.region_name, ''))as regionNames, cp.serial_number as crmProjectInformationWarehousingSerialNumber, cp.project_name as crmProjectInformationWarehousingName, enter.business_name as crmEnterpriseWarehousingName, config.name as structureTypeConfigurationName, ctel.crm_settlement_business_type_enum as crmSettlementBusinessTypeEnum, cp.estimated_cost as estimatedCost, user_b.name as createUserName from crm_tech_entrust_link as ctel left join crm_project_information_warehousing as cp on ctel.crm_project_information_warehousing_id = cp.id and cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user as user_a on ctel.user_id = user_a.id and user_a.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user as user_b on ctel.create_user_id = user_b.id and user_b.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join crm_enterprise_warehousing as enter on enter.id = cp.crm_enterprise_warehousing_id and enter.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join crm_project_information_config as config on cp.structure_type_configuration_id = config.id and config.bool_delete_enum = 0
